Accomplishment
1. Received Doctor of Pharmacy (PharmD) from Univ. of Utah

2. Full Professor of Neurology and Pharmacy Practice and Author for over 170 Journal Articles, Textbook Chapters, and Scientific Abstracts

3. Founding Senior Associate Dean o Academic Affairs at the School of Pharmacy, American Univ. of Health Sciences 2018-2019

4. Founding Department Chair of Pharmacy Practice at the College of Pharmacy, Marshall B. Ketchum Univ. 2015-2018

5. Recipient of Multiple Original Research Awards from the College of Psychiatric and Neurologic Pharmacists 2014 and 2017 and the Drug Therapy Research Award from the American Society of Health-System Pharmacists Research and Education Foundation 1999

6. Recipient of Multiple Education and Leadership Awards: Teacher of the Year, Loma Linda University 2013; Distinguished Young Pharmacist Award, California Pharmacists Association 2002; Hospital Pharmacist of the Year, Drug Topics 2000

7. Fellow of the American College of Clinical Pharmacy 2008, American Society of Consultant Pharmacists 2005, California Pharmacists Association 2002

8. Outstanding Taiwanese American Elected by T.A. Archives in 01/2019
